name: Malam-Team Technologies Ltd
summary: Malam-Team Technologies Ltd provides computer services in the field of information technology in Israel. It provides cloud architecture solutions, including cloud computing, internet, communication, and disaster recovery in cloud technology; cyber solutions; software solutions for information security; and planning and implementation of communication systems. The company also provides software development solutions for mobile, digital world, opensource solutions, Microsoft-based technology, public transportation, mainframe customer, legal proceedings and debt collection, JAVA and Oracle, and guidance and training.
